name: Zebra Technologies
description: Zebra makes the rugged handheld computers, barcode scanners, label and card printers, RFID readers, machine-vision cameras and self-service touchscreens that retail, warehouse, logistics and healthcare frontline workers use to scan, track and pay. It sells mostly through distributors and resellers (two-tier channel) and earns money on the device sale, then on recurring supplies (labels, ribbons), sensors, support and repair services and cloud software subscriptions. 82 percent of 2025 sales were tangible products and 18 percent services and software. In Q4 2025 it re-cut its segments into Connected Frontline and Asset Visibility and Automation.

employees.note: Approximately 10,700 employees in 57 countries; 44 percent in the US.

businessLines.name: Connected Frontline (CF)
businessLines.how: Sells rugged mobile computers and tablets (and, since 2025-09-30, Elo touchscreens, self-service and point-of-sale hardware) through distributors and resellers, then repair and support contracts and software subscriptions; device replacement cycles drive revenue. Services and software were $804M of the segment's $2,960M.

businessLines.name: Asset Visibility and Automation (AVA)
businessLines.how: Sells barcode and card printers, barcode scanners, fixed industrial scanning and machine-vision cameras, RFID and location systems; recurring revenue comes from labels, ribbons and other supplies and from sensors, plus a small services and software stream ($174M of $2,436M).

brands.name: Elo Holdings, Inc.
brands.note: Acquired 2025-09-30 for $1,303M cash net of cash acquired; customer-engagement and self-service touchscreens; reported in CF.

brands.name: Photoneo
brands.note: Acquired 2025-02-28 for $62M; 3D machine vision; reported in AVA.
